title: Predefining an analysis plan
outcome: Explain predefining an analysis plan using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Freeze decisions before the result. A team records its outcome, exclusions and analysis before evaluating a reserved set.
given: Plan: compare correct counts on 12 cases; exclude only unreadable files identified before scoring; report all version results.

steps.label: Write the rule first
steps.detail: Record the outcome and justified unreadable-file exclusion.

steps.label: Protect the reserved set
steps.detail: Do not choose exclusions from which cases each model fails.

steps.label: Report deviations
steps.detail: If the plan changes, mark the change and give its reason.

explanation: An analysis plan limits flexibility after outcomes are known. Necessary changes can be transparent, but they should not be silently presented as the original plan.

counterfactual.change: Exclude two readable cases because the new model fails them.
counterfactual.prediction: That outcome-driven exclusion violates the recorded rule.
counterfactual.reason: Model failure is not the predeclared unreadable-file criterion.

student_task: Apply the recorded exclusion rule. Can two readable model failures be removed, and how must a necessary later plan change be disclosed?
teacher_answer: Record the outcome and justified unreadable-file exclusion. Do not choose exclusions from which cases each model fails. If the plan changes, mark the change and give its reason. Changed case: That outcome-driven exclusion violates the recorded rule. Model failure is not the predeclared unreadable-file criterion.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: A plan cannot correct poor sampling or guarantee valid assumptions; it makes decisions auditable.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
